title: GrowthBook header (v2)
description: A violet announcement strip over a light 80px nav: wordmark, links with small chevrons, a white stars pill, a quiet sign-in link and outline + violet buttons. Sticky; on desktop it slides away while you scroll down and returns when you scroll up. Phones get a burger that opens a full-width menu.
notes: needs JavaScript for the burger menu and the hide-on-scroll (hydrate: load)
